usedFor: Shipping changes in Webshipper, such as “Return Updated”, send a message from your page in Facebook Messenger.

bestTemplate.name: “Return Updated” in Webshipper, then “Send Message from Page” in Facebook Messenger
bestTemplate.why: A changed return can reach the customer, since the action sends a message to a user from a page.

watchOut: “Send Message from Page” reaches someone outside, so each message waits in Needs you for approval.
